articles.title: Sebi appoints corporate law veteran KVR Murty as its whole-time member
articles.summary: India's capital markets regulator, Sebi, has appointed KVR Murty as its new Whole Time Member. This significant addition strengthens Sebi's leadership amidst increasing regulatory complexities and market expansion. Murty's role will be crucial in overseeing market integrity, ensuring investor protection, and reinforcing financial governance within the nation, reflecting ongoing efforts to maintain a robust economic environment.

articles.title: IOS SAGAR SHIP ARRIVES AT PHUKET, THAILAND
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence announced that the Indian Ocean Ship (IOS) SAGAR arrived in Phuket, Thailand, on April 14, 2026, after completing a six-day mission. This visit highlights India's ongoing hydrographic survey and scientific research efforts crucial for maritime domain awareness and regional cooperation in the Indian Ocean. Such engagements strengthen bilateral ties and project India's strategic influence.

articles.title: We're Hooked on Satellites. It Could Blow Up in Our Faces
articles.summary: Observers reported spotting a satellite moving persistently across the sky after sunset over the Olympic Mountains. This sighting, potentially referencing a low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite, underscores the growing visibility of artificial objects. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the critical importance of space domain awareness, understanding satellite technology, and recognizing its strategic implications for national security and technological advancement.
